description: Compare costs for multiple LLM models. Every named model is priced; pass client (e.g. 'claude_code') to also flag each model runnable_in_client (it never filters here). Recognised clients: claude_code, claude_desktop, cursor, github_copilot, windsurf, cline, continue, zed, jetbrains_ai, gemini_cli, codex_cli, aider, amazon_q, chatgpt_desktop.

client.description: Your MCP client / coding tool, so only models it can run are considered. Recognised: claude_code, claude_desktop, cursor, github_copilot, windsurf, cline, continue, zed, jetbrains_ai, gemini_cli, codex_cli, aider, amazon_q, chatgpt_desktop. Case- and separator-insensitive ('Claude Code' = claude_code). Order: explicit client > legacy ide_context > client inferred from the MCP handshake (hosted server, best effort) > none. Unknown names return an unfiltered result plus a note.

country.description: Optional ISO-3166 alpha-2 country whose currency to use (e.g. DE -> EUR, IN -> INR). A country whose currency is unsupported yields USD with fallback_to_usd=true.

currency.description: Optional ISO-4217 code to convert prices into, alongside the canonical USD figures. Beats country. Unsupported codes return success=false listing the supported set.

model_names.description: List of model names to compare (at most 50)

name: compare_costs
